__inputs.name: DS_POSTGRES
__inputs.label: Neon (rag_latency_metrics)
__inputs.description: Postgres data source pointing at Neon, using the grafana_ro role

title: rag-chat latency
description: Per-turn chat latency baseline. Cold-path metrics filter path='generated'; answer-cache returns are excluded so percentiles aren't skewed.

target.rawSql: SELECT min(created_at) AS time, release AS text, 'release' AS tags FROM rag_latency_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND release IS NOT NULL GROUP BY release

panels.title: Server first-text (generated) — p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Time-to-first-emitted-text on the cold generation path. The headline metric the optimizations move.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by server_first_text_ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by server_first_text_ms) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) within group (order by server_first_text_ms) AS p99 FROM rag_latency_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND path = 'generated' AND server_first_text_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tool-decision turn & retrieval→first-text
panels.description: decision = firstToolCall − preStream (the empty tool-decision model turn — the P1 target). toolcall_to_text = serverFirstText − firstToolCall (retrieval plus any later model/verifier work, NOT the decision itself).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (first_tool_call_ms - pre_stream_ms)) AS decision_p50, percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by (first_tool_call_ms - pre_stream_ms)) AS decision_p95, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (server_first_text_ms - first_tool_call_ms)) AS toolcall_to_text_p50 FROM rag_latency_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND path = 'generated' AND pre_stream_ms IS NOT NULL AND first_tool_call_ms IS NOT NULL AND server_first_text_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pre-stream phases (avg) — routing vs total pre-stream
panels.description: Average routing-LLM cost and total pre-stream time on the generated path.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), avg(routing_ms) AS routing, avg(pre_stream_ms) AS pre_stream FROM rag_latency_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND path = 'generated' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), path AS metric, count(*) AS turns FROM rag_latency_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, path ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Per-tool latency (generated)
panels.description: Wall time and success per tool, unnested from the latency.tools array.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t->>'name' AS tool, count(*) AS calls, round(avg((t->>'durationMs')::numeric)) AS avg_ms, round(percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by (t->>'durationMs')::numeric)) AS p95_ms, sum(((t->>'ok')::boolean)::int) AS ok_calls, sum((coalesce((t->>'cacheHit')::boolean, false))::int) AS cache_hits FROM rag_latency_metrics, jsonb_array_elements(tools) AS t WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND tools IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_ms DESC
